args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Release history shows v2.3.0 as the most recent version that was healthy in production; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying. Note that the RC also failed in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The test version of v2.3.1 had also been unhealthy in staging. Because v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before, the rollback didn't need change-manager approval.
- **Rollback:** I checked the service afterwards. All three regions are on v2.3.0, it's healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the check afterwards. It also recommends finding the root cause before v2.3.1 is redeployed, given it failed in staging too.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
